questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the phrase/idiom.

When Jane realised that she had made a serious mistake at work, she knew she had to face the ______ and take responsibility for her actions.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**music**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "face the music" is an idiom that means to confront the consequences of one's actions or to take responsibility for a mistake or wrongdoing.
 
• "Music" fits perfectly in this context, as it is part of the common idiom "face the music," which is used when someone has to deal with the negative results of their actions.
 
• Other options ("mirror," "fun," and "band") do not form a common phrase or idiom. "Mirror" and "band" do not fit the context, while "fun" is unrelated to the idea of facing consequences.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When Jane realised that she had made a serious mistake at work, she knew she had to face the music__ and take responsibility for her actions.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mirror (दर्पण)**: This does not form an idiomatic expression and is unrelated to facing consequences.
 
• **Fun (मजा)**: This word doesn't fit the idiomatic context of taking responsibility for mistakes.
 
• **Band (बैंड)**: This also doesn't form a relevant idiomatic phrase in the context of responsibility or facing consequences.

questions.question:

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains an error in the use of a phrasal verb?

options.text: Let's call off the picnic as there is a possibility of heavy rain.
Can you please take care for my belongings for some time?
It is wise to put up with one's quarrelsome neighbours.
While visiting the library, I came across an interesting book.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**To answer this question, let's break down each sentence to identify the error in the use of a phrasal verb:**

__
 
• **1) Let's call off the picnic as there is a possibility of heavy rain.**

 
 
• This sentence correctly uses the phrasal verb "call off" meaning to cancel.
 
• This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct__.
 
 
 
• **2) Can you please take care for my belongings for some time?**
 __
 
• This sentence incorrectly uses the phrasal verb "take care for".
 
• The correct phrase is "take care of".
 
• The sentence is erroneous__ because "for" should be replaced with "of".
 
• **The correct sentence would be:** "Can you please take care of my belongings for some time?"
 
 
 
• **3) It is wise to put up with one's quarrelsome neighbours.**
 __
 
• This sentence correctly uses the phrasal verb "put up with" meaning to tolerate.
 
• This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct__.
 
 
 
• **4) While visiting the library, I came across an interesting book.**
 __
 
• This sentence correctly uses the phrasal verb "come across" meaning to find by chance.
 
• This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct__.
 
 
 
• __So, out of the given sentences, only sentence 2 is erroneous due to incorrect use of the phrasal verb__.
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 2."**
